The main takeaway from our work is that
eudaimonic models of well-being offer important insights into how to promote health and longevity across the life course, and how to promote health equity across social classes.

eudaimonic models of well-being offer a promising approach to understanding the health benefits of social and cultural engagement, and the potential to reduce the health disparities that are so pervasive in modern society.
